RC-15A capture by halfSpinDoctor, audiosciencereview.com/forum/index.php?threads/remote-codes-for-topping.10708/post-639756 (2021-01-17): 'AUTO 0X11EE08F7'. That dump is IRremoteESP8266 output, which prints NEC MSB-first (its ir_NEC.cpp: 'sendNEC() sends MSB first, but protocol says this is LSB first'); reversed per byte, 0X11EE08F7 is D=0x88 S=0x77 F=0X10 ~F=0XEF. Cross-checked against github.com/Lucaslhm/Flipper-IRDB/blob/ec64ce020c45/Miscellaneous/Topping/Topping_DX3_Pro_Plus-Amplifier.ir 'AUTO' NEC address 88 command 10 -- agrees. Conflict recorded: github.com/Lucaslhm/Flipper-IRDB/blob/7ddb6eda23a3/Miscellaneous/Topping_Amplifier/Topping_DX3_Pro-Amplifier.ir gives its 'AutoSleep' as command 46, which duplicates its own Volume_Up and is taken as an error there; Aldoszx's Tasmota list (audiosciencereview.com/forum/index.php?threads/remote-codes-for-topping.10708/post-1810970, 'Auto', DataLSB 0x887710EF) agrees with the capture.
